reason: In scope (A3 bullet 2): the retained, evaluated object is a non-weight hierarchical experience-rule pool edited by a reflection LM from execution trajectories (and golden test patches) and read by the actor on later issues.

paper.title: LLMs as Continuous Learners: Improving the Reproduction of Defective Code in Software Issues
paper.central_claim: EvoCoder continuously distills general and repository-specific reproduction rules from past trajectories (compared with golden test patches), maintains them in a hierarchical pool via Add/Remove/Merge/Endorse/Modify, and thereby improves issue-reproduction accuracy on SWE-bench Lite by ~20% over prior SOTA and helps downstream issue resolving, without fine-tuning.
paper.scope_class: A: retained editable textual experience pool

gap.author_gap: 现有 issue 复现方法只处理常见错误，难以适应各仓库特有且持续变化的错误和约定。
gap.checked_gap: 成立：对 CodeR 失败的人工分类（内部错误 58.55%）及 Finding 1/2 说明存在跨库通用与库特有两类错误，动机较具体。最近邻覆盖：CodeR、SWE-agent、LIBRO（少样本同库示例）有定量对比；经验池类近邻（Liu 2024d、Wang 2024b）只在文字上批评「膨胀/僵化」，无对照实验。动机统计分母不一致（84 vs 82，E016/E017）。
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: LIBRO（few-shot 复现）→ SWE-agent/CodeR（agent 内置固定提示）→ 本文（可演化经验池）；记忆侧：经验池/工作流记忆类方法（本地仅有 AWM 在同批，未核）。
gap.residue: 无池关闭（store-off）下 Actor 改造的单独效应；经验写入依赖 golden patch；池规模动态与膨胀/僵化未量化；评测靠 LLM/人评。
gap.stakes: issue 复现是修复流水线的前置步骤，下游解决数与之相关（E014）。
gap.method_response: 分层池+显式编辑操作回应「通用/库特有」并抑制膨胀；对照 golden patch 提供较强信号。
gap.remaining_gap: 池效应归因、真值可得性假设、留出与成本、膨胀证据。
unresolved: 经验池类近邻（ExpeL/AWM 等）无对照实验；Actor 骨干模型文中未指明，不能确认与基线同模型

assessment.evidence_level_note: Whole-system reproduction accuracy improves on the evaluation stream, but the pool is written from that same stream using its golden test patches and no same-actor pool-off arm exists; per EVIDENCE rule 2 (selection signal from the evaluated set) the improvement cannot be certified as retained improvement.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Under the authors' SWE-bench Lite protocol (GPT-4 and human judging, single run), the full EvoCoder system reproduces 54.0/53.3% vs 45% for an adapted LIBRO and 34% for CodeR; removing the edit operations or either pool layer lowers accuracy by 4–8 points. Attribution to retained experience, and generalization beyond an oracle-informed stream, are not established.
unresolved: Golden-patch use and issue ordering/retry protocol unspecified.

G.reason: Concrete gap backed by a manual failure taxonomy of the SOTA reproducer (common vs repository-specific errors) and compared to LIBRO/CodeR; prior experience pools named and critiqued (bloat/rigidity). Not 4: no empirical comparison to an existing experience-pool method, and the taxonomy's denominator is internally inconsistent (84 stated vs 82 implied).

M.reason: Hierarchical general/repo pool + explicit edit vocabulary + golden-patch-grounded reflection targets the stated repo-specific vs general error split and yields a distinguishable prediction (general pool helps new repositories; repo pool helps recurring setups). Not 4: relies on a privileged golden test patch and the actor scaffold changes confound the mechanism story.

X.reason: Prompts, the five operations, the >20-rules forced merge/remove, visibility scopes, top-10 selection and importance counts are reconstructible. Unclear key conditions: issue processing order and any same-issue retry after reflection, when golden patches become visible, how the 'five intrinsic errors' verification is executed, how 'consistently failing' rules are detected for removal, pool size over time.

E.measurement.reason: No execution-based oracle (fail-on-buggy/pass-on-fixed was available via golden patches but dismissed); GPT-4 judge plus human judges on five self-defined criteria aligned with the actor prompt; human-rater count, protocol, blinding and agreement statistics not reported; downstream resolved counts give a weak external check.

E.causality.reason: Action/general/repo ablations and an adapted same-library few-shot baseline (LIBRO) exist. Missing: a same-actor pool-off arm (every ablation keeps some pool), so actor standardization/verification steps are not separated from retained experience; actor backbone/budget matching unstated.

E.holdout.reason: The evaluation set is the construction stream; the write signal is the evaluation instances' golden test patches (A2: ground-truth signal → E.holdout); order/split/cold-start unspecified; possible same-issue retry unspecified; no repository holdout or contamination analysis. Only mitigation: an issue's own patch is not visible to the actor during its first attempt.

E.statistics.reason: 300-item counts with LLM/human numbers and consistent ablation direction, but single run with no intervals or order variance; downstream +3/+2 issues on an unexplained 68-issue subset with a mis-printed delta (2.54 vs 2.94); motivation denominator inconsistent (A2 ladder 1).
